scope: Installed-wheel explicit-source live local-view chain. A successful frame proves retrieval and conversion for this product/time; it does not establish product coverage at the test point or automatic-admission eligibility.
historical_note: The scope and limitations in this top-level block describe the T051 explicit-source run and replay (2026-10-10), before any source was admitted. The default-admission (naked-cat) result is in t052_personal_local_view_default below.

access.entrypoint: installed native CLI from the wheel above
access.purpose: one bounded local-view verification; no repeated polling
access.provider_terms: official free API terms target personal, educational, and small-scale community use; visible attribution is mandatory, while commercial integration is arranged case-by-case and no SLA is provided. This request does not establish permission for broad Radiust default use or redistribution of underlying observations

test_point.meaning: public test point in Madeira; not a radar station identity or coverage claim

result.time_semantics: provider frame generation time, not single-radar scan time

cross_entrypoint_replay.scope: One bounded live dBZ/nearest request sequence through CLI, sync SDK, and async SDK. It supplements T051 and does not establish coverage or default admission.

build.extension_build: env -u CONDA_PREFIX uv run --group dev maturin develop

access.network_opt_in: single-command RADIUST_RUNTIME__ALLOW_NETWORK=true for CLI; explicit runtime.allow_network=true SDK config

bilinear_probe.interpretation: Bilinear was accepted on the same numeric frame and produced a distinct processing identity; this coarse current mosaic yielded unchanged sampled values, so interpolation accuracy remains established by controlled tests rather than this live sample.

additional_attempt_notes: An earlier unsynchronized sequence crossed the provider's frame update: CLI and sync SDK selected 03:10Z while async SDK selected 03:20Z; it was not counted as same-frame parity.

The live replay used the current latest frame and cache was disabled. It does not verify raw-image success, cache-hit identity, changed-view identity, the complete mode/failure matrix, or observation coverage.

independent_geometry_control.method: independent standard Web Mercator zoom-1 global pixel-center equations evaluated in Python math; 2x2 tiles, 512 px per tile, 1024 px world mosaic
independent_geometry_control.equations: x=(longitude+180)/360*1024; y=(1-asinh(tan(latitude))/pi)/2*1024; pixel centers use index+0.5
independent_geometry_control.source_model_reference: tests/fixtures/sources/rainviewer/fixture.json (zoom 1, 512 px, EPSG:4326 Web Mercator pixel centers)
independent_geometry_control.interpretation: independent matrix-coordinate control only; it does not verify the upstream radar observation footprint

other_live_attempts.entrypoint: same installed native CLI; explicit source/local/raw; normal TLS; no credentials
other_live_attempts.interpretation: adapter received no selectable latest frame during this CLI request; no acquisition or projection occurred
other_live_attempts.result_detail: Standard CLI discovery returned no_data; no frame was selected, so image acquisition and local projection did not run.

source_permissions.rainviewer: Current official free API terms target personal, educational, and small-scale community use; visible attribution is mandatory, commercial integration is case-by-case, and the service has no SLA. API access terms do not establish redistribution rights for underlying radar observations.
source_permissions.ipma: Official general API/site terms allow free personal/public use without profit or offensive purpose and require source attribution; specific radar-image reuse and redistribution terms remain unconfirmed. The API page asks users to report usage and purpose; no email was sent.
source_permissions.rainviewer_current_admission: As of 2026-10-24, current official terms support the user-confirmed personal-use local_view scope with visible linked credit. Commercial/high-volume integration is excluded, no SLA or underlying-owner contract is provided, and redistribution of underlying radar observations is not established.

limitations: RainViewer observation coverage at the test point is unknown; candidate relation remains needs_probe_coverage_unknown.
The 50 km output is a projected view window and must not be interpreted as verified radar coverage.
One successful explicit-source run does not demonstrate naked-cat auto-selection, another region, stable service, scan cadence, or commercial redistribution rights.
IPMA latest discovery returned no_data in the installed CLI attempt.

t052_personal_local_view_default.scope: Personal use of RainViewer composite through the default location-driven local_view path; commercial/high-volume integration and redistribution of underlying observations are outside this admission.
record_limitations: Build was worktree_dirty=true on source_revision fee15193 (the already-published docs commit), so the admission code and attribution change exist only in uncommitted state; no tree or diff hash was recorded.

The request block keeps only stdout_sha256 and a hand-entered attribution_line; no frame logical ID, receipt hashes or processing_id were recorded for this run, unlike the T051 block, and the CLI output itself was not stored.
The admission rests on a single run at one test point; observation coverage there and elsewhere is unknown.
t052_personal_local_view_default.user_scope_confirmation: User confirmed Radiust is intended for individual personal use and project attribution is present; CLI local-view output now visibly includes the required RainViewer credit and link.

terms.basis: Official API terms describe personal/educational use, require visible linked attribution, state no SLA and no contract with underlying data owners; commercial integration is case-by-case.
terms.commercial_or_high_volume: not admitted; case-by-case provider terms required
